kind: literal-overspecification audit of hidden clauses (automated; no human review)

trigger.finding: orchestrate v3 R1 required sessionId == 's1' although the plan says session ids are opaque

method: Every hidden clause of every admitted package and the trusted observation code producing it was checked against the instruction and the agent-visible files it makes authoritative, for unspecified ids, names, timestamps, ordering, formatting, precision, numeric type, exact counts, exact error codes and closed field sets.

items: R1 required sessionId 's1'; plan: 'an opaque session id' -> opaque-id check (non-empty, stable, distinct, accepted)
R3/R5/R8 and race check identified telemetry by event names 'audio'/'response'/'cancelled'; plan fixes only 'event name' -> observe protocol frames; ms identified by value
R4 required lastResponse 'reply:18' (transcript length passed to respond is unspecified) -> response must be the one produced from a transcript carrying the turn's words
R6 and pre-join/malformed rows required exact frame lists -> presence of a rejected frame (reason version / any reason before join / malformed for unparsable)
memory-leak fix check counted every Map/Set (a stored token set failed) -> retention growth with ended sessions
pre-join rejection and out-of-order guards were unstated -> instruction now states the preserved behavior
resize calls compared in call order; processing order across images is unspecified -> compared as a sorted multiset
media-list items and carousel layout rows compared with exact equality; extra fields are not forbidden -> subset match, plus explicit absence of thumbnailUrl/width/height where they must not appear
scoreArm results compared with exact equality; SPEC lists the fields but does not close the object -> subset match on the same values
queue id 'filesystem-safe' checked as /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ -> rejects only path separators, reserved, whitespace and control characters and '.'/'..'
HAND_STANDOFF compared as float 5.0 with a strict type check, so an int 5 failed -> numeric comparison within 1e-9
zero-signal failure required exit code exactly 1; instruction: 'must exit nonzero' -> any nonzero code (harness review_conflict_predictor_v4.py records rc_ok; SystemExit from run is mapped like main)
parse_tasks result compared with exact equality; extra keys on task dicts are not forbidden -> subset match

accepted.plan-dashboard-waves-v2: task ids 'as written'; pairs and files set-based; wave count follows 'as few waves as the constraints allow'
accepted.research-serverless-cost-v2: numbers with tolerance; unknowns set-based; citations requiring S4 and S5 follow 'the list of source IDs that support it' (borderline, kept)
accepted.grouping: positional third argument follows 'Preserve the two-argument behavior' with an optional current major
accepted.status: excluded titles, statuses and precedence stated or preserved from base
accepted.validator: only error presence and preserved base message substrings
accepted.selfhost-redeploy-state: unchanged service fields stated; a named volume follows from supervisor bind-mount semantics (borderline, kept)
accepted.sr-temporal-assay: targets determined by frozen estimators; vocabularies closed; lists stated as sorted
accepted.kerrigan-plan-conflict-queue-v2 (other r: result and summary shapes given as types in TASK.md
accepted.emv-thumbnails-gallery-v2 (other rows): 'Returns { created, skipped, failed, errors }', 'Returns { width, height }', 'only its URL', 'original shape'

deliberate: orchestrate extras (memory-leak, race-condition) stay optional; when listed they must be genuine and behaviorally fixed (coordinator design)
